This source tree is vendored for the OneString ABD integration.

Excluded from this repository:
- meshes/
- inputs/
- comparisons/
- docs/
- notebooks/

The OneString backend generates its own scene JSON, tile OBJ files,
guide constraints, rope manifest, pull schedule, and output files.
